Pricing | AI Selfie Studio - Professional AI Headshots

name: AI Selfie Studio
summary: AI headshot generator: turns a single selfie into dozens of professional profile photos for social and resume use.
description: Upload one selfie and the app generates 54+ headshot styles, from studio and corporate to editorial, cinematic and creative, ready in under a minute in 4K. One-tap portrait filters adjust skin, expression, gaze, outfit and colour, and a built-in AI photo editor removes or replaces backgrounds and fine-tunes colour and lighting. Aimed at professionals and teams who need profile pictures without a photographer.
contains: 54+ AI headshot styles from one selfie
credit packs: $15 for 15 images, $25 for 50, $39 for 100, $99 for 300
one credit equals one generated image; credits do not expire
built-in AI photo editor: background removal and replacement, effect presets, colour and lighting
team section: consistent headshots for a whole team page at $29 per employee
